title: Tangy Asparagus Stir-Fry
description: A simple and flavorful vegetarian stir-fry made with poached asparagus, tangy sauce, and crisp white onions.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add asparagus and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Stir in tang, white pepper, and salt to taste.
Add sliced onions and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped green onions if desired.
Cook's note: For an extra kick, add a dash of red pepper flakes.
Cook's note: To poach asparagus, bring a pot of water to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add asparagus to the pot, cover, and cook for 4-6 minutes, or until tender.
Drain and rinse with cold water to stop cooking.
